```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# SETTING UP LIBRARIES
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(Metrics)
library(forecast)
library(randomForest)
library(pdp)
```

```{r}

data = read.csv("../data/data_merged.csv")
data_mean = read.csv("../data/prevail_mean.csv")

data$date <- as.Date(data$date)
data_mean$date <- as.Date(data_mean$date)

data <- data %>%
  select(
    date,
    log_ret,
    matches("_L[1-4]$")       # only lagged features
  ) %>%
  select(-matches("price")) %>% 
  left_join(
    data_mean %>% select(date, mean_prevailing_ret),
    by = "date"
  )

```


##XGBoost with Hyperparameter Tuning
```{r}

# Use same train/test split as Random Forest
# train_data and test_data already defined (206 / 52 split)

xgb_df <- data %>%
  arrange(date) %>% 
  select(-mean_prevailing_ret) %>%
  drop_na()

set.seed(123)

n <- nrow(xgb_df)
train_size <- floor(0.8 * n)  # 206 quarters
test_size  <- n - train_size  # 52 quarters

train_data <- xgb_df[1:train_size, ]
test_data  <- xgb_df[(train_size + 1):n, ]

cat("\n=== Data Split ===\n")
cat("Training set:", train_size, "quarters\n")
cat("Test set    :", test_size, "quarters\n\n")

# --- STEP 2: Hyperparameter tuning ---

train_tune_size <- floor(0.8 * train_size)  # 165 quarters
val_tune_size   <- train_size - train_tune_size  # 41 quarters

X_train_tune <- train_data[1:train_tune_size, ] %>% select(-date, -log_ret)
y_train_tune <- train_data$log_ret[1:train_tune_size]

X_val_tune   <- train_data[(train_tune_size + 1):train_size, ] %>% select(-date, -log_ret)
y_val_tune   <- train_data$log_ret[(train_tune_size + 1):train_size]

dtrain_tune <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_train_tune), label = y_train_tune)
dval_tune   <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_val_tune),   label = y_val_tune)

xgb_param_grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth        = c(3, 4, 5, 6),
  eta              = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
  nrounds          = c(100, 200, 300),
  subsample        = c(0.7, 0.8, 0.9),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8)
)

best_val_rmse_xgb <- Inf
best_params_xgb   <- NULL
best_nrounds      <- NULL

cat("\n=== XGBoost Hyperparameter Tuning ===\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(xgb_param_grid)) {
  params <- list(
    objective        = "reg:squarederror",
    max_depth        = xgb_param_grid$max_depth[i],
    eta              = xgb_param_grid$eta[i],
    subsample        = xgb_param_grid$subsample[i],
    colsample_bytree = xgb_param_grid$colsample_bytree[i]
  )
  
  model_temp <- xgb.train(
    params = params,
    data   = dtrain_tune,
    nrounds = xgb_param_grid$nrounds[i],
    watchlist = list(train = dtrain_tune, val = dval_tune),
    verbose = 0,
    early_stopping_rounds = 20
  )
  
  preds_val <- predict(model_temp, dval_tune)
  rmse_val  <- sqrt(mean((y_val_tune - preds_val)^2))
  
  if (rmse_val < best_val_rmse_xgb) {
    best_val_rmse_xgb <- rmse_val
    best_params_xgb   <- xgb_param_grid[i, ]
    best_nrounds      <- model_temp$best_iteration
  }
}

cat("\n=== Best XGBoost Parameters ===\n")
cat("Best Val RMSE:", round(best_val_rmse_xgb, 6), "\n\n")

# --- STEP 3: Recursive CV ---

cat("=== Starting Recursive XGBoost Forecasting ===\n")

xgb_recursive_preds <- rep(NA_real_, test_size)

for (t in 1:test_size) {
  # expanding window up to current test quarter
  train_subset <- xgb_df[1:(train_size + t - 1), ]
  test_point   <- xgb_df[train_size + t, , drop = FALSE]
  
  X_train <- train_subset %>% select(-date, -log_ret)
  y_train <- train_subset$log_ret
  X_test  <- test_point  %>% select(-date, -log_ret)
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_train), label = y_train)
  dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(X_test))
  
  params_final <- list(
    objective        = "reg:squarederror",
    max_depth        = best_params_xgb$max_depth,
    eta              = best_params_xgb$eta,
    subsample        = best_params_xgb$subsample,
    colsample_bytree = best_params_xgb$colsample_bytree
  )
  
  xgb_model_final <- xgb.train(
    params  = params_final,
    data    = dtrain,
    nrounds = best_nrounds,
    verbose = 0
  )
  
  xgb_recursive_preds[t] <- predict(xgb_model_final, dtest)
  
}


cat("Prediction complete!\n")

xgb_df$xgb_forecast_ret <- c(rep(NA, train_size), xgb_recursive_preds)

```


## Plot XGBoost model against actual and prevailing mean model 
```{r}

plot_xgb_df <- xgb_df %>%
  left_join(
    data %>% select(date, mean_prevailing_ret),
    by = "date"
  )

# ONLY PLOT TEST SET (last 52 quarters)

ggplot(plot_xgb_df %>% tail(test_size), aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = log_ret,            color = "Actual returns")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_prevailing_ret, color = "Prevailing-mean forecast")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = xgb_forecast_ret,    color = "XGBoost forecast")) +
  labs(
    title = "S&P 500 Log Return Forecasts: XGBoost vs Prevailing Mean vs Actual",
    subtitle = paste("Test period:", test_size, "quarters (Q207-Q258)"),
    x = "Year",
    y = "Log Return",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# EVALUATE ONLY ON TEST SET
xgb_eval_df <- plot_xgb_df %>%
  tail(test_size) %>%  # Only last 52 quarters (test set)
  filter(
    !is.na(log_ret),
    !is.na(xgb_forecast_ret),
    !is.na(mean_prevailing_ret)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    err_xgb   = log_ret - xgb_forecast_ret,
    err_mean = log_ret - mean_prevailing_ret
  )

cat("\n=== TEST SET PERFORMANCE (Q207-Q258, n =", nrow(xgb_eval_df), "quarters) ===\n\n")

# MAE, RMSE, R²
actual <- tail(xgb_df$log_ret, test_size)
pred   <- xgb_recursive_preds

MAE_xgb  <- mean(abs(actual - pred))
RMSE_xgb <- sqrt(mean((actual - pred)^2))
R2_xgb   <- cor(actual, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2


cat("=== XGBoost Forecast Performance ===\n")
cat("MAE :", round(MAE_xgb, 6),
    "\nRMSE:", round(RMSE_xgb, 6),
    "\nR²  :", round(R2_xgb, 4))

#DM Test
dm_test_xgb <- dm.test(
  e1 = xgb_eval_df$err_xgb,
  e2 = xgb_eval_df$err_mean,
  alternative = "less"   # H1: XGBoost has lower expected error
)

cat("\n\n=== DM Test: XGBoost VS Prevailing Mean ===\n")
cat("DM Statistic:", round(as.numeric(dm_test_xgb$statistic), 3),
    "\nP-value:", signif(dm_test_xgb$p.value, 4), "\n")

# === Conclusion Interpretation ===
if(dm_test_xgb$p.value < 0.05) {
  cat("\nConclusion: The p-value < 0.05 → We reject the null hypothesis.\n")
  cat("XGBoost has significantly lower forecast error\n")
  cat("than the Prevailing Mean model.\n")
} else {
  cat("\nConclusion: The p-value >= 0.05 → We fail to reject the null hypothesis.\n")
  cat("XGBoost does not significantly outperform the Prevailing Mean Model.\n")
}
```

##Feature Importance
```{r}
# Feature importance (Top 10 by Gain)
imp_tbl <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_model_final, 
                          feature_names = colnames(train_data %>% select(-date, -log_ret)))

imp_top10 <- imp_tbl %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = Gain, n = 10) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels = rev(Feature)))

ggplot(imp_top10, aes(x = Feature, y = Gain)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "XGBoost Feature Importance (Top 10)",
       x = "Feature", y = "Gain") +
  theme_minimal()

```
